preconditions.expression: 1 <= len(s) <= 200 and all(c.islower() for c in s)
preconditions.description: Input string s consists of lowercase English letters and has length between 1 and 200.
Integer n is a positive integer up to 10^9.

postconditions.description: Output is the number of distinct palindromes obtainable by inserting exactly n lowercase letters into s, modulo 10007.

postconditions.expression: count_palindromes(s, n) == sum(1 for _ in generate_palindromes(s, n))
postconditions.description: The count is the number of distinct palindromes formed by inserting exactly n letters into s, where each insertion is a lowercase English letter at any position.
